name: io.github.ameerasofficial-ai/devops-doctor
title: DevOps Doctor
description: Package, dependency, CI and config safety checks for coding agents. Pay per call.

tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Live check against the npm / PyPI registry and the OSV vulnerability database. Catches hallucinated package names, typosquats, deprecated packages and known vulnerabilities. Price 0.005 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

name.description: Package name, e.g. express or requests

version.description: Optional version to check for vulnerabilities (defaults to latest)

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: diagnose_devops_error
tools.description: Send an error message from Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform, Vault, Nginx or Linux. Returns likely cause, fix steps and commands to verify, as JSON. Price 0.02 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

error.description: The error message or log lines (max 4000 chars)

context.description: Optional: what you were doing, tool versions, platform

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: check_config_file
tools.description: Finds YAML syntax errors with line numbers plus common deploy-breaking and security mistakes: selector/label mismatch, :latest images, missing resource limits and probes, privileged containers, hard-coded secrets, GitHub Actions security (pwn-request checkouts on pull_request_target, actions not pinned to a commit SHA, script injection from issue/PR titles, secrets printed to logs, write-all tokens, self-hosted runners on PRs, curl | bash), root Docker images. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: scan_dependencies
tools.description: Send package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, package.json, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock, go.mod, go.sum, Cargo.lock, composer.lock or Gemfile.lock. Checks up to 1000 exact versions against OSV.dev and returns every vulnerable package with CVE, severity and the version to upgrade to, plus names that look like typosquats of popular packages. Not charged if the vulnerability database is down. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

content.description: The lockfile or manifest text (max 3 MB)

filename.description: Optional file name, e.g. package-lock.json (helps detection)

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.
